terms.definition: Orbital element-set evidence and related orbital consistency, identity and cause assessments.
A proposed interpretation was issued as a judgment with evidence and explicit limitations.
Computed disagreement between element-set predictions evaluated at the later epoch; not a physical-cause determination.
An evidence-backed proposed association of a source-scoped referent with a candidate identity; not identity equivalence.
An evidence-backed proposed explanation of specified evidence, retaining alternatives and limitations; not confirmed causation.
